- **YAML Validation**: Checked local workflow syntax and validated that all referenced paths (such as `backend/requirements.txt`, `frontend/package-lock.json`, and `e2e/package-lock.json`) map to existing local workspace locations.
- **Remote Execution & Local Docker State**: Explicitly marked remote GitHub execution and local Docker environment execution as **not performed** in compliance with the local-only workflow constraint. Application tests were not run as no code logic was changed.
